binary32_word_schema: All fields named *_word*, *_words* or f32_words_u32 encode decimal U32 binary32 bits; integer flags, counts, holds and generations remain integers.

state_schema.secondary_peak: 6 F32 words same internal order; LFE remains zero

statistics_sequence.reset_rule: Reset only before sequence_step0; steps1..7 consume exclusively preceding computed actual next_state, never expected_state.

recipes.1: (ch+1)/16 at i in {0,255,256,1535}, else positive zero
recipes.final_conversion: For primary R32(v); for secondary R32(v*3/4), including negative-zero preservation. All formulas except explicit zero are exact dyadic rationals.

statistics_sequence.synthetic_secondary: independent recipe; no new forward/inverse reconstruction execution claimed

output_schema.energy_blocks: 6 records: mean_square_five[5] F32 words, summed_power F32 word, normalized_level F32 word
output_schema.auxiliary_raw_peaks_six: 6 F32 words; each is F06ND.4 aux_peak after previous_downmix carry and before normalize, not aux_current

scheduler_sequence.reset_rule: Reset only before sequence_step0. Each next step consumes computed actual previous state, never expected_state. Statistics and scheduler tests are separate sequences.

input_recipe.peak_pattern: select index%6 from patterns; each has6 entries j=0..5

output_schema.packed_control_fields: RF_packed_word_u16, RF_aux_packed_word_u16, RF_limiter_packed_word_u16 and three Line_* arrays contain U16; flags U16; minimum_line_signed I16
